QUESTION: The value «COBADEFFXXX» is an important fact of this letter: it is printed on the line «BIC: COBADEFFXXX», the line above it is «IBAN: DE02 1203 0000 0000 2020 51». What does the letter call this value? Copy the printed words that name it (not the value itself).
ANSWER FORMAT: the printed words in double quotes

asks.name: extra:name
asks.question:
QUESTION: The value «0800 555 0199» is an important fact of this letter: it is printed on the line «0800 555 0199», the line above it is «Team Forderungen». What does the letter call this value? Copy the printed words that name it (not the value itself).
ANSWER FORMAT: the printed words in double quotes

asks.name: text:other
asks.question:
QUESTION: Give a short name for this kind of document. Write it in the letter's own language.
ANSWER FORMAT: one line of text in double quotes

asks.name: text:title
asks.question:
QUESTION: Write a title of at most 8 words for this other: who wrote it and what it is for. Write it in the letter's own language.
ANSWER FORMAT: one line of text in double quotes
asks.answer: "Dear Mustermann, this letter is a payment reminder for a mobile phone bill"

asks.name: text:subject
asks.question:
QUESTION: Copy the subject line of the letter exactly as it is printed.
ANSWER FORMAT: the subject line in double quotes
asks.answer: "Zahlungserinnerung /1. Mahnung- Rechnung 2026-08-771204 / Sehr geehrte Frau Mustermann,"

asks.name: text:summary
asks.question:
QUESTION: Write one or two sentences saying what the reader must know or do. Copy sentences from the letter where you can. Write it in the letter's own language.
ANSWER FORMAT: one or two sentences in double quotes
asks.answer: "Zahlungserinnerung /1. Mahnung- Rechnung 2026-08-771204 / Sehr geehrte Frau Mustermann, Zahlungseingang festzustellen. Falls sich Ihre Zahlung mit diesem Schreiben überschnitten hat, betrachten Sie es bitte als gegenstandslos."

asks.name: text:questions
asks.question:
QUESTION: Write three short questions the reader may ask about the content of this letter (for example about an amount, a deadline or what to do next). Write it in the letter's own language.
ANSWER FORMAT: three questions, each in double quotes, separated by spaces
asks.answer: "Was ist der offene Betrag?" "Wie lange ist die Frist für die Zahlung?" "Welchen Bankkontoinhaber ist der Empfänger?"
